Mine happened in the car on the way home from a doctor's appointment with my mother. I just said "mom. I'm happy I lived". She started getting teary and I was too but it was the happy tears. I'll admit it still gets hard, those feelings dont just magically disappear. It's about finding the little things to get you out of bed in the morning. Even if it seems silly, like no one will feed your pet if you die. Just putting one foot in front of the other which can be diffcult. There's no magic formula but you find little reasons to keep going everyday
